meta.label: FDA drug label data (openFDA), with plain-language wording written by the team
meta.not: clinical guidelines, a complete list of side effects or interactions, or prescribing advice

combination_rules.label: General overlap flags — not a complete interaction checker, drug-interaction database, or advice about which medicines to stop

pairs.title: ACE inhibitor and ARB on the same list
pairs.detail: Using an ACE inhibitor together with an ARB is a combination clinicians often review closely. This flag is not a complete interaction check and is not an order to stop either medicine.

pairs.title: Two acid-reducing classes on the same list
pairs.detail: A PPI and an H2 blocker sometimes appear together, and sometimes that overlap is worth a visit question. This is a discussion flag, not advice to drop one.

pairs.title: More than one as-needed migraine class
pairs.detail: A triptan and a gepant on the same list is something people often double-check with a clinician (timing, how often each is used). This app cannot say they must or must not be combined.

drugs.name: Lisinopril
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Relaxes blood vessels so blood pressure comes down.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney and potassium blood tests. A dry cough that does not go away.

drugs.name: Amlodipine
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Relaxes blood vessels and eases the workload on the heart.
drugs.monitoring_note: Ankle swelling. Blood pressure readings at home.

drugs.name: Hydrochlorothiazide
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. A water pill that helps the body get rid of extra salt and water.
drugs.monitoring_note: Blood tests for body salts (electrolytes). Staying hydrated and using sun protection.

drugs.name: Losartan
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Relaxes blood vessels so blood pressure comes down.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney and potassium blood tests.

drugs.name: Metoprolol
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day. Slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rate and energy level. Tell your clinician if you have asthma.

drugs.name: Propranolol
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet or capsule taken once or a few times a day. Slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rate and energy level. Tell your clinician if you have asthma.

drugs.name: Metformin
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day with meals. Lowers blood sugar mainly by reducing the sugar the liver releases.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney function and how your stomach handles it.

drugs.name: Empagliflozin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Helps the kidneys remove extra sugar through urine.
drugs.monitoring_note: Staying hydrated. Genital infections. Nausea, vomiting or stomach pain that could signal ketones.

drugs.name: Semaglutide
drugs.typical_use_note: Usually a once-weekly injection; a daily tablet form also exists. Acts like a gut hormone that raises insulin after meals and lowers appetite.
drugs.monitoring_note: Stomach symptoms, eating enough, and how to use the injection pen.

drugs.name: Glipizide
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day, usually before a meal. Helps the pancreas release more insulin.
drugs.monitoring_note: Signs of low blood sugar and keeping regular meals.

drugs.name: Sitagliptin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Helps the body make more insulin after meals.
drugs.monitoring_note: Unusual stomach pain and new joint pain.

drugs.name: Cetirizine
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Blocks histamine to ease sneezing, itching and a runny nose, usually with less drowsiness than older allergy pills.
drugs.monitoring_note: Whether it makes you sleepy, and other allergy medicines you take.

drugs.name: Loratadine
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Blocks histamine to ease sneezing, itching and a runny nose, usually with less drowsiness than older allergy pills.
drugs.monitoring_note: Drowsiness is most likely if you take more than the label says. Any rash, swelling or trouble breathing needs medical help right away.

drugs.name: Fluticasone (nasal)
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Daily nasal spray. Calms swelling inside the nose.
drugs.monitoring_note: Spray technique and nosebleeds.

drugs.name: Montelukast
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet, usually taken in the evening. Blocks a body chemical that causes airway swelling and allergy symptoms.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any mood or behavior changes, such as agitation or trouble sleeping. Tell your clinician right away.

drugs.name: Omeprazole
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily capsule, often taken before a meal. Lowers the amount of acid the stomach makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: How long you need to stay on it and other acid medicines you take.

drugs.name: Pantoprazole
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Lowers the amount of acid the stomach makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: How long you need to stay on it and other acid medicines you take.

drugs.name: Famotidine
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day, or as needed. Lowers the amount of acid the stomach makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: Timing with meals and other medicines.

drugs.name: Esomeprazole
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily capsule. Lowers the amount of acid the stomach makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: How long you need to stay on it.

drugs.name: Sumatriptan
drugs.typical_use_note: Taken as needed at the start of a migraine. Narrows swollen blood vessels in the head and blocks pain signals during a migraine.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any history of heart disease and how often you use it.

drugs.name: Rizatriptan
drugs.typical_use_note: Taken as needed at the start of a migraine. Narrows swollen blood vessels in the head and blocks pain signals during a migraine.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any history of heart disease and how often you use it.

drugs.name: Topiramate
drugs.drug_class: Anticonvulsant (seizure medicine also used to prevent migraine)
drugs.typical_use_note: Daily tablet for prevention. It is not an as-needed medicine for a migraine attack. Calms overactive nerve signals in the brain.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood, staying hydrated, kidney stones, and pregnancy plans.

drugs.name: Ubrogepant
drugs.typical_use_note: Taken as needed at the start of a migraine. Blocks a protein that plays a role in migraine pain.
drugs.monitoring_note: How it fits with your other migraine medicines.

drugs.name: Enalapril
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day. Relaxes blood vessels so blood pressure comes down.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney and potassium blood tests. A dry cough that does not go away.

drugs.name: Benazepril
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Relaxes blood vessels so blood pressure comes down.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney and potassium blood tests. A dry cough that does not go away.

drugs.name: Diltiazem
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet or capsule taken once or several times a day, depending on the type. Relaxes blood vessels and eases the workload on the heart.
drugs.monitoring_note: Ankle swelling. Blood pressure readings at home.

drugs.name: Chlorthalidone
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. A water pill that helps the body get rid of extra salt and water.
drugs.monitoring_note: Blood tests for body salts (electrolytes). Staying hydrated and using sun protection.

drugs.name: Valsartan
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day. Relaxes blood vessels so blood pressure comes down.
drugs.monitoring_note: Kidney and potassium blood tests.

drugs.name: Atenolol
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rate and energy level. Tell your clinician if you have asthma.

drugs.name: Carvedilol
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken twice a day with food. Slows the heart and lowers blood pressure.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rate and energy level. Tell your clinician if you have asthma.

drugs.name: Furosemide
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day. A strong water pill that removes extra fluid through urine.
drugs.monitoring_note: Blood tests for body salts and kidneys. Signs of dehydration.

drugs.name: Spironolactone
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. A water pill that keeps potassium in the body.
drugs.monitoring_note: Potassium and kidney blood tests.

drugs.name: Atorvastatin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Slows how much cholesterol the liver makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: Muscle pain or weakness that is unexplained. Liver blood tests when your clinician asks for them.

drugs.name: Rosuvastatin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Slows how much cholesterol the liver makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: Muscle pain or weakness that is unexplained. Liver blood tests when your clinician asks for them.

drugs.name: Simvastatin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet, usually taken in the evening. Slows how much cholesterol the liver makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: Muscle pain or weakness that is unexplained. Liver blood tests when your clinician asks for them.

drugs.name: Pravastatin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Slows how much cholesterol the liver makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: Muscle pain or weakness that is unexplained. Liver blood tests when your clinician asks for them.

drugs.name: Ezetimibe
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Blocks some of the cholesterol in food from being absorbed.
drugs.monitoring_note: Muscle pain (especially if taken with a statin). Liver blood tests.

drugs.name: Glimepiride
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet taken with breakfast. Helps the pancreas release more insulin.
drugs.monitoring_note: Signs of low blood sugar and keeping regular meals.

drugs.name: Pioglitazone
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Helps the body respond better to its own insulin.
drugs.monitoring_note: Swelling, sudden weight gain or shortness of breath, which can be signs of heart failure.

drugs.name: Diphenhydramine
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet, capsule or liquid taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Blocks histamine to dry up a runny nose and ease itching. It often causes sleepiness.
drugs.monitoring_note: Strong sleepiness, confusion in older adults, and other sedating medicines.

drugs.name: Albuterol
drugs.typical_use_note: Inhaled puffs taken as needed for wheezing or shortness of breath. Quickly relaxes the muscles around the airways so it is easier to breathe.
drugs.monitoring_note: Needing your rescue inhaler more often than usual. Heart rate.

drugs.name: Pseudoephedrine
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet or liquid taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Shrinks swollen nasal passages so it is easier to breathe.
drugs.monitoring_note: High blood pressure or heart problems. It is sold from behind the pharmacy counter.

drugs.name: Lansoprazole
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily capsule, taken before a meal. Lowers the amount of acid the stomach makes.
drugs.monitoring_note: How long you need to stay on it and other acid medicines you take.

drugs.name: Loperamide
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule or liquid taken after loose stools, up to a daily limit. Slows the gut so stools become firmer.
drugs.monitoring_note: Never take more than the daily limit; very high doses can cause dangerous heart rhythm problems. See a clinician if diarrhea lasts more than 2 days or there is blood.

drugs.name: Ondansetron
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet or dissolving tablet taken before treatment or as needed. Blocks a signal in the gut and brain that triggers nausea.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rhythm problems, and other medicines that raise serotonin.

drugs.name: Polyethylene glycol
drugs.typical_use_note: Powder mixed into a drink once a day. Draws water into the bowel to soften stools.
drugs.monitoring_note: Diarrhea, or constipation that lasts more than a week.

drugs.name: Warfarin
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet at the same time each day. The dose is adjusted using blood tests. Makes the blood slower to clot.
drugs.monitoring_note: Regular blood tests (called INR) that show how well it is working, unusual bleeding, and how other medicines and foods rich in vitamin K change its effect.

drugs.name: Apixaban
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken twice a day. Makes the blood slower to clot.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any unusual bleeding, and telling every clinician you take it before surgery or dental work.

drugs.name: Rivaroxaban
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day, depending on the reason. Makes the blood slower to clot.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any unusual bleeding, and telling every clinician you take it before surgery or dental work.

drugs.name: Clopidogrel
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Keeps blood cells called platelets from sticking together and forming clots.
drugs.monitoring_note: Unusual bleeding, and other blood thinners on your list.

drugs.name: Aspirin
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken as needed for pain, or once a day at a low dose for heart protection. Keeps blood cells called platelets from sticking together and forming clots.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, and other blood thinners on your list. Only take daily low-dose aspirin if a clinician recommends it.

drugs.name: Levothyroxine
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet, usually taken on an empty stomach in the morning. Replaces the thyroid hormone your body is not making enough of.
drugs.monitoring_note: Blood tests of thyroid levels, and taking it the same way every day. The side effects listed can mean the dose is too high.

drugs.name: Zolpidem
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken right before bed, only when you can stay in bed for a full night. Slows brain activity so it is easier to fall asleep.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepwalking or other unusual sleep behavior, and drowsiness the next day.

drugs.name: Sertraline
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet or liquid. Raises serotonin, a brain chemical that helps steady mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm, especially in the first weeks or after a dose change. Do not stop suddenly without asking.

drugs.name: Escitalopram
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Raises serotonin, a brain chemical that helps steady mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm, especially in the first weeks or after a dose change. Do not stop suddenly without asking.

drugs.name: Fluoxetine
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily capsule or tablet. Raises serotonin, a brain chemical that helps steady mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm, especially in the first weeks or after a dose change. Do not stop suddenly without asking.

drugs.name: Citalopram
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Raises serotonin, a brain chemical that helps steady mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm, especially in the first weeks or after a dose change. Do not stop suddenly without asking.

drugs.name: Bupropion
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day, depending on the type. Affects the brain chemicals dopamine and norepinephrine to lift mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm. The risk of seizures is higher at higher doses.

drugs.name: Trazodone
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken once or twice a day, often in the evening. Affects brain chemicals that help regulate mood.
drugs.monitoring_note: Mood changes or thoughts of self-harm, and sleepiness the next day.

drugs.name: Buspirone
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken two or three times a day. Eases anxiety without making most people very sleepy. It takes a few weeks to work.
drugs.monitoring_note: Dizziness, and alcohol or other sedating medicines.

drugs.name: Alprazolam
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken as needed or a few times a day. Calms the nervous system, which eases anxiety.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepiness, memory problems and dependence. Never combine with opioids or alcohol unless a clinician says it is safe.

drugs.name: Lorazepam
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken as needed or a few times a day. Calms the nervous system, which eases anxiety.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepiness, memory problems and dependence. Never combine with opioids or alcohol unless a clinician says it is safe.

drugs.name: Acetaminophen
common_side_effects: liver damage if too much is taken
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet, capsule or liquid taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed, up to a daily limit. Eases pain and lowers fever.
drugs.monitoring_note: The total amount from all products, since many cold and pain products also contain acetaminophen. Alcohol use.

drugs.name: Ibuprofen
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet or liquid taken every 4 to 8 hours with food as needed. Reduces pain, swelling and fever by blocking body chemicals that cause inflammation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, blood pressure, kidney function, and use with blood thinners.

drugs.name: Naproxen
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken every 8 to 12 hours with food. Reduces pain, swelling and fever by blocking body chemicals that cause inflammation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, blood pressure, kidney function, and use with blood thinners.

drugs.name: Meloxicam
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Reduces pain, swelling and fever by blocking body chemicals that cause inflammation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, blood pressure, kidney function, and use with blood thinners.

drugs.name: Diclofenac
drugs.rx_otc: OTC or Rx (depends on the product)
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken a few times a day, or a gel rubbed on sore joints. Reduces pain, swelling and fever by blocking body chemicals that cause inflammation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, blood pressure, kidney function, and use with blood thinners.

drugs.name: Celecoxib
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule taken once or twice a day. Reduces pain, swelling and fever by blocking body chemicals that cause inflammation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Black stools or stomach pain, blood pressure, kidney function, and use with blood thinners.

drugs.name: Tramadol
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken every 4 to 6 hours as needed. Changes how the brain senses pain.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepiness, slowed breathing and dependence. Never combine with benzodiazepines or alcohol unless a clinician says it is safe.

drugs.name: Gabapentin
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule or tablet taken up to three times a day. Calms overactive nerve signals.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepiness and dizziness, especially with alcohol or opioid pain relievers.

drugs.name: Cyclobenzaprine
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken up to three times a day, for short periods. Eases muscle spasms by calming nerve signals to the muscles.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sleepiness, and use with other sedating medicines.

drugs.name: Allopurinol
drugs.typical_use_note: Once-daily tablet. Lowers uric acid so gout attacks are less likely.
drugs.monitoring_note: A new rash (call your clinician right away), plus kidney function and uric acid blood tests.

drugs.name: Amoxicillin
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule, tablet or liquid taken two or three times a day. Kills bacteria or stops them from growing.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any past allergy to penicillin. A rash or trouble breathing could be an allergic reaction.

drugs.name: Azithromycin
drugs.typical_use_note: Usually a short course of tablets, often once a day for a few days. Stops bacteria from growing.
drugs.monitoring_note: Heart rhythm problems, and other medicines you take.

drugs.name: Cephalexin
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule or liquid taken a few times a day. Kills bacteria or stops them from growing.
drugs.monitoring_note: Any past allergy to penicillin or similar antibiotics.

drugs.name: Ciprofloxacin
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken twice a day for a set number of days. Kills bacteria by stopping them from copying their DNA.
drugs.monitoring_note: Tendon pain or swelling, tingling or numbness, and sun sensitivity. Call your clinician right away if any of these happen.

drugs.name: Doxycycline
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule or tablet taken once or twice a day, with a full glass of water. Stops bacteria from growing.
drugs.monitoring_note: Sun protection, and spacing it apart from calcium, iron and antacids.

drugs.name: Nitrofurantoin
drugs.typical_use_note: Capsule or liquid taken with food, usually a few times a day. Kills bacteria in the urinary tract.
drugs.monitoring_note: Numbness or tingling, and any new cough or trouble breathing.

drugs.name: Metronidazole
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken two or three times a day. Kills certain bacteria and parasites.
drugs.monitoring_note: Avoid alcohol while taking it and for a few days after. Numbness or tingling.

drugs.name: Sildenafil
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken about an hour before sexual activity, no more than once a day. Increases blood flow so an erection can happen with stimulation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Never combine with nitrate heart medicines, which can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Sudden vision or hearing loss needs urgent care.

drugs.name: Tadalafil
drugs.typical_use_note: Tablet taken as needed, or once a day at a low dose. Increases blood flow so an erection can happen with stimulation.
drugs.monitoring_note: Never combine with nitrate heart medicines, which can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Sudden vision or hearing loss needs urgent care.
